next_checks.rationale: Secondary supply mostly tracked its setpoint (mean gap 0.83°C, 142/144 samples within 2°C) over the prior 24h, but no room/radiator reading exists to confirm rooms actually received adequate heat.

Only primary network meter flow/heat power (declining from 448 l/h and 24.33 kW at start to 296.67 l/h and 14.67 kW at end) is available; secondary/customer circuit flow feeding the complaint is not measured.

A prior activity-type disturbance record starting 2015-02-27 exists for this asset; maintenance records should be checked for related work, though it predates and doesn't establish this report's cause.
